title: Helix Semantic Token Naming Grammar
description: Formalizes the key grammar for semantic.color.{fill,text,icon,border}.* keys documented in packages/tokens/CLAUDE.md's "Semantic naming vocabulary" (decided 2026-08-21): {role}[-interactive][-modifier][-state]. This is the STRUCTURAL/vocabulary half of token-name validation only — it checks that a key is built from the right words in the right order. It deliberately does NOT (and cannot) check the one rule that matters most in practice: whether a `-light`/`-dark` modifier is correct RELATIVE to a token's siblings in the same role group (e.g. is this really the lightest of three tones?) — that's a comparison across resolved values, which a per-key schema has no way to see. scripts/verify-token-naming.ts still owns that check; this schema and that script are complementary, not redundant — see packages/tokens/CLAUDE.md for the prose version of these same rules and scripts/token-naming-lib.ts for the banned-segment list this schema's `not` block mirrors.

role.description: The base semantic role a color token stands for. Not every role appears under every surface (fill/text/icon/border) — see roleBySurface in this file's `examples` for the real per-surface set as of 2026-08-25.

modifier.description: A tone added BESIDE a role's base value — the base itself never carries one, even if it happens to be the lightest/darkest in its group (see packages/tokens/CLAUDE.md's border.default/border.neutral example).

state.description: Interaction state — only ever present when the literal 'interactive' segment is also present, EXCEPT for the documented link exception (link-hover has no 'interactive' marker, since link has no non-interactive sibling use to disambiguate from).

bannedSegment.description: A hyphen-delimited segment that must never appear in a semantic/component token key — mirrors scripts/token-naming-lib.ts's BANNED_SEGMENTS exactly. Each has one required replacement, spelled out in `bannedSegmentReplacements` below rather than here (JSON Schema `not` can reject, but can't express 'use X instead' as part of the validation itself).

generalGrammarKey.description: The general-case grammar: {role}[-interactive[-modifier]-state][-modifier]. The interactive block, when present, bundles its own optional modifier with its required state (matching fill.primary-interactive-light-default); a role can ALSO carry a bare trailing modifier with no interactive block at all (matching text.neutral-light, border.neutral-dark).

documentedExceptionKey.description: Keys that don't follow generalGrammarKey because the role itself is a standalone utility value (no interactive/modifier/state axis at all) or — for link/link-hover — because the role is interactive by definition with no non-interactive sibling, so the 'interactive' marker is deliberately skipped per packages/tokens/CLAUDE.md's own documented exception.

roleBySurface.$comment: The real per-surface role set in packages/tokens/src/tokens.json as of 2026-08-25 — not every role in $defs/role appears under every surface. Regenerate this block by hand if the vocabulary changes; nothing currently derives it automatically.

counterExamples.$comment: Real violations this schema rejects — mirrors scripts/token-naming-lib.ts's own worked examples.
counterExamples.fill.primary-hover: missing the required 'interactive' marker before a state segment
